## Design note

The tradesman's truck: a small, light pickup with a light rear end that steps out in the wet and a gearbox that likes to be rowed. Slow, but honest, cheap and hard to kill — every other driveway in the suburbs has one.

## How this car breaks

Separate ladder frame and steel bumpers shrug off low-speed knocks, and the bed is just bent sheet. The 90s regular cab is the weak point: thin pillars and no real crumple zone ahead of a short nose, so hard frontals and anything above frame height go into the cab.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 90s compact pickups
- road-test figures for the class (0-100, braking, skidpad)
- engineering tables (truck tire radius, leaf-spring ride frequency, disc/drum brake hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 620 | 0.85 | 530 |
| pitch | 2874 | 0.95 | 2730 |
| yaw | 2908 | 0.97 | 2820 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 2.27 m²; Cd = 0.45 → **CdA = 1.022 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.15 / +0.15 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

2.4 L SOHC 8-valve I4, multi-point injection, truck calibration. Class-typical 90s 2.4 L compact-truck four (~44 kW/L, ~106 kW at 5000 rpm, ~218 N·m at 4000) per manufacturer spec-class data.

Peak **107 kW @ 5400 rpm**, **218 N·m @ 4000 rpm**. Idle 700 / redline 5500 / limiter 5800 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.15 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 26 N·m. Power-to-weight 78 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed manual, open rear differential on a leaf-sprung live axle. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.35 × peak torque = 290 N·m. Shift time 0.35 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.83 | 15.70 | 42 |
| 2 | 2.22 | 9.10 | 72 |
| 3 | 1.40 | 5.74 | 114 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 4.10 | 159 |
| 5 | 0.86 | 3.53 | 185 |

Final drive 4.10, reverse 3.83. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.315 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.25 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 368 kg | 1.30 Hz | 24600 N/m | 1500 N·s/m | 2250 N·s/m | 0.18 m |
| Rear | 238 kg | 1.60 Hz | 24100 N/m | 1200 N·s/m | 1800 N·s/m | 0.20 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.5°/g with 72% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.553 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 77602 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 25108 F / 23936 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **15000 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 5.3°/g, front share 70%. Bump stops 200000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 3.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 274 mm disc, pistons per side 60 mm → A = 28.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 112 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·28.3 cm²·0.112 m = **2407 N·m**
- Rear: 254 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 22.0 mm → A = 3.80 cm², drum radius 127 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **869 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1715 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.41×), rear needs 407 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.14×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 572 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.603** → delivered 2410 N·m front / 573 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1340 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 18.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.4 m → outer-front path radius 5.59 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.10 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.608 rad (34.8°)** (outer 30.6°, inner 40.1° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.0 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/furrow_24.json`)

252 nodes, 1536 beams, 6 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id furrow_24 --profile truck --width 1.69 --length 4.75 --height 1.6 --wheelbase 2.85 --mass 302.0 --car-mass 1372.7 --clearance 0.2 --front-overhang 0.8 --strength 1.15` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 4).
- Era `90s` passenger cell: 138 cabin/sill, 139 cross-member, 8 pillar, 8 roof rail → hss × 0.75 section.
- Steel hood: 105 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 14 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 12 under-cab rail beams → hss 1.92e-04 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Side-saddle fuel tank outboard of the left frame rail between cab and rear axle.
